title: Del Mar
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at 'Del Mar', a Gulf Front luxury 9-bed, 9.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 20 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Gulf Front with Private Beach Access (Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31) - Gulf Facing Resort Style Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $60 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Elevator - Six Seater Golf Cart - Six Adult Bikes Nestled within the prestigious enclave of Seacrest Beach, this brand-new Gulf Front estate epitomizes coastal luxury at its finest. . Situated along 69 feet of pristine Gulf shoreline on the coveted east end of 30A, this remarkable legacy property boasts a commanding elevation over 30 feet above sea level, encompassing over half an acre of meticulously landscaped grounds complete with a gated private parking court and breathtaking western views. Boasting a staggering nine bedrooms, nine full bathrooms, and one half bathroom, this expansive retreat comfortably accommodates up to twenty guests, making it an ideal haven for large families or gatherings of friends seeking an unforgettable beachfront experience Reflecting the timeless allure of low country architecture, this four-story sanctuary spans 7,966 square feet of meticulously crafted living space, featuring nine bedrooms and nine-and-a-half bathrooms. The interiors exude a relaxed sophistication, showcasing panoramic views of the emerald-green Gulf waters from every vantage point within the home. The ground level showcases an impressive garage with space for over eight vehicles, a rare and invaluable feature along 30A. Ascend to the second level to discover the heart of the home, where a grand living area seamlessly transitions to the resort-style pool deck, offering an infinity-edge pool, a sunken dining area with a swim-up bar, and a private boardwalk leading to the sandy beach. Designed for culinary enthusiasts, the chef's kitchen is adorned with top-of-the-line Wolf appliances, Sub-Zero refrigeration, quartzite countertops, and custom cabinetry. A butler's pantry provides additional storage, prep space, wine storage, and a dishwasher for effortless entertaining. The third and fourth levels feature two spacious primary suites, each boasting dual vanities, walk-in showers, and private balconies with stunning Gulf views. Additional bedrooms on these levels provide ample accommodation for guests, each with its own indoor and outdoor living areas for added comfort and privacy. Embrace the tranquility of coastal living while being just moments away from the vibrant communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, offering world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment options. This extraordinary estate epitomizes luxury beachfront living at its finest, offering a rare blend of privacy, sophistication, and unparalleled coastal beauty. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor -Bunk Room - Two Queen over Queen bunks - Private Bathroom Shower Only Second Floor -Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower only -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower only - Half Bathroom Third Floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower only -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower only -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Fourth Floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower only -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub **Fireplaces not for guest use**
